347:t_2:68.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$ゼウス$$ saved us from that crisis.」

347:t_2:69.en:
$$桂$$
「Is that god with you and the others too, $$甲児$$?」

347:t_2:70.en:
$$甲児$$
「No... $$ゼウス$$ is operating separately from us to fight $$バアル$$ in his own way.」

347:t_2:71.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「After that, both groups were separately transported to some parallel world... a beautiful part of space located at the galactic center.」

347:t_2:72.en:
$$宗介$$
「So you went through the same process we did...」

347:t_2:73.en:
$$甲児$$
「In our case, both groups were then transported to $$木星$$ and met up there.」

347:t_2:74.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「At $$木星$$, a $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ base took us in, and we received $$刹那$$'s $$ダブルオークアンタ$$ there, but...」

347:t_2:75.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We encountered a new enemy, $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

347:t_2:77.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The name stands for $$地球外変異性金属体$$.」

347:t_2:78.en:
$$マオ$$
「So they're strange metal creatures from space.」

347:t_2:79.en:
$$クルツ$$
「They're creatures from space hostile to humanity...」

347:t_2:81.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...We can't say for sure yet, but what makes $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ frightening is their ability to assimilate through erosion.」

347:t_2:82.en:
$$桂$$
「By assimilate... you mean they swallow machines and make them part of their own bodies?」

347:t_2:83.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「That's right. $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ attacks also damage the minds and brains of the pilots inside.」

347:t_2:84.en:
$$甲児$$
「Once that damage builds up and you can't fight anymore, you can't escape the erosion.」

347:t_2:85.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So pilots who've accumulated damage have no choice but to retreat.」

347:t_2:86.en:
$$マオ$$
「Another troublesome bunch has shown up...」

347:t_2:87.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「We don't know whether the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ that appeared near $$木星$$ were transported by accident or are an advance force...」

347:t_2:88.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「But since we can't communicate with them and know neither their identity nor purpose, all we can do now is stay alert.」

347:t_2:89.en:
$$マオ$$
「...At least I understand this: we and Earth are in serious trouble.」

347:t_2:90.en:
$$桂$$
「All kinds of $$バアル$$ are invading from outer space, while $$サイデリアル$$ and its allies act like they own Earth.」

347:t_2:91.en:
$$宗介$$
「The answer is simple. We'll crush them all.」

347:t_2:92.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's why we're heading for Earth.」

347:t_2:93.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah... If they're all enemies, we'll fight them all.」

347:t_2:94.en:
$$宗介$$
(Wait for me, $$千鳥$$... We... I will save you.)

347:t_2:103.en:
$n
「...I'm sorry! Is it time for a briefing?」

347:t_2:104.en:
$$スズネ$$
「No, it isn't. I only came to check on you.」

347:t_2:105.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It seems you still need time to sort out your thoughts...」

347:t_2:107.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Don't push yourself. I'll come get you again when it's time to eat.」

347:t_2:108.en:
$$スズネ$$
(He wavers between hope and despair... Learning $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ is alive makes his hope swell, and his despair grow at the same time...)

347:t_10:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...It seems $n still needs some time.」

347:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do you mean $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$?」

347:t_10:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Ever since he infiltrated our group on $$翠の地球$$, he's shown a strong obsession with $$セツコ$$.」

347:t_10:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「At first I thought it was romance or something, but now it seems different...」

347:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Could it be related to the $$スフィア$$s after all?」

347:t_10:10.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I don't know. But we'll need to stay alert.」

347:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Certainly, when $$バルビエル$$ fought you, $$クロウ$$, his excitement rose unusually high.」

347:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I added the 50 Z worth of $$Ｚチップ$$s produced then to the unit's stock.」

347:t_10:15.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No... I was just thinking it'd be nice if money sprang up that easily too, instead of just $$Ｚチップ$$s...」

347:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Sigh... Talking to a miser like you is depressing, $$クロウ$$.」

347:t_10:17.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You're a chip miser! How can you say that!?」

347:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's a pleasure to meet you, $$万丈$$. I am $$ＡＧ$$, $$ＤＥＭ$$'s agent robot.」

347:t_10:23.en:
$$万丈$$
「Thank you for your polite greeting. I'm counting on you from now on, $$ＡＧ$$.」

347:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all. I hoped to build a good relationship with the $$破嵐財閥$$ too...」

347:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My apologies...! I... seem to have been a little off the mark.」

347:t_10:27.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Hey, you're a dimensional merchant who travels between parallel worlds, right?」

347:t_10:28.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Could that $$破嵐財閥$$ you mentioned refer to a parallel world's $$万丈$$?」

347:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh! The two beautiful assistants are here too!」

347:t_10:30.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Of course. Wherever $$万丈$$ goes, I'm there.」

347:t_10:31.en:
$$レイカ$$
「I'm counting on you from now on, $$ＡＧ$$.」

347:t_10:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well... I'd be delighted to have you count on me.」

347:t_10:33.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「Then, let's get back to what we were talking about...」

347:t_10:34.en:
$$レイカ$$
「Hey, what's $$万丈$$ like in that parallel world? Of course, I was the one beside him, right?」

347:t_10:35.en:
$$ビューティ$$
「What are you saying, $$レイカ$$!? Obviously, it was me!」

347:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...I understand. If you're going to argue that much, let me tell you a little about an episode I know.」

347:t_10:39.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There, $$万丈$$ works as a private detective in a floating city on $$東京湾$$.」

347:t_10:41.en:
$$レイカ$$
「He's a private detective... Then his partner has to be me, a student at the $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ prep school, right?」

347:t_10:43.en:
$$トッポ$$
「...It looks like this'll take a while, Big Bro $$万丈$$.」
